methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $10M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Standard Subsea, a seed-stage ocean and maritime technology company founded by Christopher Amidon, has raised $10M+ to date. The valuation analysis is informed by three private peer companies in the ocean and maritime sector: Clippership, NetworkOcean, and Albacore. No comparable public companies exist in this specialized frontier segment.

A stage-progression methodology was applied as the primary valuation driver. Using the $10M total capital raised as a proxy for current enterprise value, a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $25M. This reflects the standard capital step-up and risk reduction associated with advancement from seed funding.

The triangulated valuation range supports a $21M to $29M band, with a median point estimate of $25M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single applicable methodology; broader triangulation would typically employ revenue multiples or DCF approaches, which are not available in the provided dataset. Key uncertainties include the absence of financial performance data, the nascent public comp universe in frontier ocean tech, and the limited visibility into peer valuations. The valuation should be stress-tested as additional operational and revenue-stage data becomes available.
